text: A Grothendieck fibration p: E → B has the property that for every morphism f:a→b in B and e:E above b, there is a Cartesian lift of f to E above a. This models:
choices: Substitution (pulling back types along context morphisms)
explanation: Cartesian lifts in a fibration model substitution: pulling back the type P(b) along f gives P(a)=P(f(-)).
